subject: Fastest air freight option: HAM to DEL
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you send me an all-in air freight quote in EUR for the fastest option from HAM to DEL (Delhi, IN)?

We’ll deliver the shipment to Hamburg airport (HAM) ourselves, and it’ll be ready on 2026-11-26. It’s 1 piece of electronic control units, with a gross weight of 1666 kg and a volume of 7.78 cbm.

Could you also let me know the latest drop-off time at HAM and the earliest arrival at DEL?

Thanks for checking!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG
